_readme: Benchmark scenes for the performance contract (docs/mobile/10-performance.md §4). Budgets here must satisfy the global frame gates in packages/tokens/tokens.json (frameBudget), enforced by mobile/scripts/test.mts. Runner scripts arrive in R3 on-device; these scene definitions are the contract they execute.

AnswerStream.description: 4000-token answer with three fenced code blocks, streaming with the pacing engine at cinematic shaping, scroll pinned to the tail.
steps: expand one code block during stream

Reader300.description: 300-page PDF open, page jump, continuous scroll, highlight placement with two handle drags.
steps: place a highlight in under 10ms first-pixel
close and relaunch with 10000 highlight records

QuizRun.description: Six question types in sequence (mc, tf, short, fill, ordering, matching) with feedback animation overlapping the next question's entry.
steps: trigger one wrong (shake-x) while entering the next

LibraryScroll.description: 10000 rows, fling to bottom, type a query that matches 4000 rows.

GalleryOpen.description: Screenshot viewer opening over a live streaming chat.

VoiceHold.description: Hold-to-talk with the level meter glow active and the composer mounted.

SearchBurst.description: Ten queries in a row against the 200 ms tier-2 budget, per-lane results, one lane intentionally unreachable to exercise why().

FloodWatch.description: Companion flood streaming per-agent progress into the radio room; the phone stays at Full ladder on the device floor.
steps: expand one scratchpad while events arrive
